verdict.rationale: The SDK docs say OAuth lets your users authorize access to their own accounts on services like Slack and GitHub. Platform docs add that each user connects their own apps instead of sharing broad credentials, and Workforce turns user-authorized access into agent-usable access. Per-session tool filters and per-environment auth configs give some scoping, but the evidence never shows how a session is bound to one specific end user's connected account or how per-user tokens are issued. missing for 10: documented per-end-user token or credential binding in SDK sessions, explicit per-user scoped token issuance, hands-on or independent corroboration of per-user isolation.
